summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the engine-free plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and the thin ignite adapters. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver); nifti_writer default dtype now np.float32; plot_2d_or_3d_image added to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py; TensorBoardImageHandler gains index and delegates to the plot function; SegmentationSaver (output_dir, dtype=None) and ClassificationSaver (filename before overwrite, engine-accepting finalize wrapper) delegate to the savers; callers in two segmentation_3d examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py renamed to output_dir; tests added for CSV, NIfTI, segmentation handler, and plot, and the classification test passes filename. Verification: by reading only. No tests were run, no packages installed, and flake8 was not run. Line length, trailing newlines, and comma spacing were checked by grep and look clean. Nothing is committed.
